title: (fix) O3-5693: Trim queue entry representation to what the table renders
body:

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
`useQueueEntries` requested the full visit → encounters → obs/diagnoses/providers graph, deep `queue`/`status`/`priority` concept reps, and the full `person` — ~95% of which the queue table never displays. Because these are lazy associations, requesting them forces them to load on the server.

This trims the representation to only the fields the table and its actions/modals actually read, cutting both the payload and the server-side lazy-load cascade.
